description: This file defines the ProductReviewDao interface, which provides data access methods for product reviews, including fetching reviews by customer, product, or both, and retrieving reviews in specific languages.

classes.name: ProductReviewDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to product reviews, extending generic entity DAO for CRUD operations.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews submitted by a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews for a specific product in a given language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a single review for a product by a specific customer.
